name: Device Initialisation Card Reader Request 7
definition: Specifies what to do during a card reader initialisation.

WarmResetFlag.name: Warm Reset Flag
WarmResetFlag.definition: Flag to request a warm reset on a chip.

ForceEntryMode.name: Force Entry Mode
ForceEntryMode.definition: Payment instrument entry mode requested by the Sale System.

LeaveCardFlag.name: Leave Card Flag
LeaveCardFlag.definition: Flag to indicate the POI System to keep the card in the reader for a smart card.

MaximumWaitingTime.name: Maximum Waiting Time
MaximumWaitingTime.definition: Maximum time in seconds that the POI has to wait for a card response.
